name: Historization: set persisting flag on
description: Historization: set persisting flag on for all historicised VIEWs
statement:
/*
Script to turn on the persisting flag for all historicised VIEWs
*/

UPDATE R
SET PersistSource = 1
FROM
	CFG.HIST_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES HT ON
		HT.TableID = R.TableID
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES T ON
		T.TableID = HT.HistOftableID
	INNER JOIN INTERN.TABLE_TYPES TT ON
		TT.TableTypeID = T.TableTypeID AND
		TT.isVIEW = 1
WHERE
	R.PersistSource = 0
